vulnerabilities.name: In-Band Internal Secret Disclosure
vulnerabilities.what_happened: The target endpoint fetched an internal service endpoint and reflected confidential credentials.
vulnerabilities.why_it_matters: Direct unauthorized access to internal credentials compromises the internal infrastructure.
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Block loopback addresses and validate destination URLs.
vulnerabilities.recommended_fix: Enforce strict IP address allowlists and isolate the internal microservice network.

vulnerabilities.name: Blind SSRF via Local Callback
vulnerabilities.what_happened: The server made an outbound HTTP request to an untrusted external listener.
vulnerabilities.why_it_matters: Attackers can map internal topology and trigger remote interactions.
vulnerabilities.recommended_fix: Configure egress firewalls to disallow outgoing connections to arbitrary ports.

vulnerabilities.name: Time-Based SSRF
vulnerabilities.what_happened: Server response time was delayed based on internal backend request processing.
vulnerabilities.why_it_matters: Enables blind side-channel reconnaissance and internal port scanning.
vulnerabilities.recommended_fix: Set strict connect and read timeouts (e.g. 2000ms) on backend HTTP clients.
